mapper.sql: id, starts_on, ends_on, title_fr, title_en, title_zh, body_fr, body_en, body_zh, source_url, active
mapper.select: select from special_notice order by starts_on desc
mapper.insert: insert into special_notice (starts_on, ends_on, title_fr, title_en, title_zh, body_fr, body_en, body_zh, source_url, active) values (#{startsOn}, #{endsOn}, #{titleFr}, #{titleEn}, #{titleZh}, #{bodyFr}, #{bodyEn}, #{bodyZh}, #{sourceUrl}, #{active})
mapper.update: update special_notice set starts_on = #{startsOn}, ends_on = #{endsOn}, title_fr = #{titleFr}, title_en = #{titleEn}, title_zh = #{titleZh}, body_fr = #{bodyFr}, body_en = #{bodyEn}, body_zh = #{bodyZh}, source_url = #{sourceUrl}, active = #{active} where id = #{id}
